title: Floor & Decor Opens New Store in Fort Worth, Texas

# Floor & Decor Opens New Store in Fort Worth, Texas


[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_ea37f14270184a90c459b30b362c1fab/flooranddecor/news/2026-11-19_Floor_Decor_Opens_New_Store_in_Fort_Worth_313.pdf) November 19, 2026 8:35am EST


*—* *Leading specialty retailer of hard-surface flooring adds its third Fort Worth-area location, bringing its Dallas-Fort Worth footprint to 14 locations—*


ATLANTA--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- Floor & Decor (NYSE: FND), a leading specialty retailer of hard-surface flooring for professionals and homeowners, today announced the opening of its newest warehouse store and design center in Fort Worth, Texas, at 6700 West Freeway. The new location joins two existing Floor & Decor stores in the Fort Worth area and brings the company’s total in the Dallas-Fort Worth area to 14, including its Design Studio.


The Fort Worth store opens with a team of approximately 40 associates led by Christian Fields, the store’s Chief Executive Merchant.


The new store gives Fort Worth-area homeowners and professionals local access to a broad assortment of in-stock tile, wood, laminate, vinyl, and natural stone options, along with installation materials, decorative accessories, and related categories at everyday low prices.


“We’re excited to open our newest Floor & Decor store in Fort Worth,” said Fields. “Our team is ready to help homeowners and professionals find the right products for their projects, with expert guidance and great value all under one roof. We look forward to serving even more of the Fort Worth community.”


The new Fort Worth store opens to customers today. The official grand opening celebration kicks off with a ribbon-cutting ceremony on Monday, November 30, and continues through Tuesday, December 29, with a 30-Day Grand Opening Celebration.


**Ribbon Cutting Ceremony** Floor & Decor will celebrate its grand opening with a ribbon cutting ceremony on Monday, November 30, at 10 a.m. CT, in partnership with the Fort Worth Chamber of Commerce. Following the ceremony, the Easy Slider food truck will serve free food to the first 200 customers until 1 p.m.


**30-Day Grand Opening Celebration** The Fort Worth store will extend its grand opening celebration with 30 days of special offers, giveaways, and in-store events. From November 30 through December 29, customers can enjoy:


- **Limited-Time Savings:** 15% off installation materials*
- **Weekly $1,000 Gift Card Giveaway:** Customers can register in store daily for a chance to win a $1,000 Floor & Decor gift card. One gift card will be given away in each of five weekly drawings, for five gift cards in total, with drawings held December 6, 13, 20, and 27, and a final drawing on December 30**
- **Free Breakfast Mondays:** Beginning December 7, free breakfast for the first 200 customers from 7 a.m. to 10 a.m.:


- December 7 and 21: Flat Top Biscuits and Gravy
- December 14 and 28: 3F Premier Catering


- **Daily Giveaways:** Free items for the first 100 customers each day, with a new item each week:


- November 30–December 5: Tote Bag
- December 6–12: Bucket
- December 13–19: Hat
- December 20–23 and December 26: Lunch Box
- December 27–29: T-shirt


- **Vendor Demonstrations:** Vendor representatives will be in the store from 7 a.m. to noon to provide demonstrations, answer questions, and share product information:


- MAPEI: November 30–December 4
- Schluter: December 9–10
- LATICRETE: December 14–18
- wedi: December 21–22


**Store Facts**


- Location: 6700 West Freeway, Fort Worth, TX 76116
- Store Hours: Monday–Friday 7 a.m.–8 p.m.; Saturday 8 a.m.–7 p.m.; Sunday 10 a.m.–6 p.m. CT
- Phone Number: (682) 285-0755
- The store will be closed on Thursday, November 26 (Thanksgiving Day), Thursday, December 24, and Friday, December 25, 2026


*Offer valid for all purchases of Grout, Mortar, Tools & Accessories, Surface Preparation Material, Self Leveler, Sealers, Cleaners, Uncoupling Membranes, Backer Board, Shower Systems, Primer, Floor Heating, Drains, Waterproofing, Niches, Pan Liners, Profiles and Trims, Caulk, Vents and Registers, Adhesives, Underlayment, Moldings, Stair Treads & Stair Parts at the Fort Worth Floor & Decor location between 11/30/2026 and 12/29/2026. Offer valid in-store only and not available for online purchases made at[flooranddecor.com](http://flooranddecor.com/) . Limited to current in-store stock. Offer not valid on previous purchases. Cannot be combined with any other offer, coupon, or discount.


**No purchase necessary to enter or win. A purchase does not increase your chances of winning. Open to legal U.S. residents of OK and TX who reside within 250 miles of Fort Worth, TX who are 18 years of age or older at the time of entry. Void where prohibited. See complete Official Rules at[www.flooranddecor.com/ftworthpro](http://www.flooranddecor.com/ftworthpro) for details including entry periods, eligibility restrictions, prize description and ARV. Registration location: Floor & Decor, 6700 West Freeway, Fort Worth, TX 76116. Sweepstakes registration is open during normal store hours and begins on 11/30/2026 and ends on 12/29/2026.


**About Floor & Decor Holdings, Inc.** Floor & Decor is a multi-channel specialty retailer of hard-surface flooring and related accessories and seller of commercial surfaces. As of September 24, 2026, the Company operated 282 warehouse-format stores and five design studios across 39 states. The Company offers a broad in-stock assortment of laminate and vinyl, tile, wood, and natural stone flooring and installation materials and decorative accessories, as well as adjacent categories, at everyday low prices. The Company was founded in 2000 and is headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia.
